checks: Layer eye, Solo, enabled comp, work area, layer in/out, opacity, blend modes, track matte, guide layer, 3D view, collapsed transformations, alpha, effects
fix: Start by switching to Active Camera/Front as appropriate and temporarily bypass suspect mattes/effects.

symptom: Layer is black where it should be transparent
checks: Transparency Grid is a *preview aid*; comp background color isn't alpha, solid-color source may be opaque
fix: Toggle Transparency Grid and inspect Alpha channel, not simply black RGB. Choose output format with alpha if needed.

checks: Codec/container doesn't preserve alpha; transparency interpreted as black in player
fix: Use ProRes 4444 or appropriate PNG/EXR sequence with RGB+Alpha and correct alpha interpretation. Standard H.264 MP4 doesn't export an alpha channel.

checks: Track Matte source assignment, Alpha vs Luma, invert, source visibility, matte layer alpha/brightness
fix: Select the matted layer, choose its matte source with pick whip/dropdown. Matte source may be elsewhere in layer stack.

checks: Effects & Presets search, installed plugin, effect hidden in Obsolete group, renderer or bit-depth limitations
fix: Confirm exact effect name/category; inspect supported 8/16/32-bpc and GPU icons, then verify plugins.

checks: Property is collapsed, layer not selected, Timeline search filter, expression-only animation
fix: `U` shows keyed properties; `UU` modified properties; `EE` expressions. Clear Timeline search.

checks: Relevant properties are not exposed
fix: Reveal keyframes with `U` and clear search/filter.

checks: Wrong panel focus; text cursor active; laptop Fn mapping; OS intercept; custom shortcut
fix: Click correct panel; press `Esc` to leave text edit; check Edit → Keyboard Shortcuts.

symptom: `G/Q` draws a mask instead of a shape
checks: Existing footage/solid layer selected vs no layer selected; Tool Creates Shape/Mask setting
fix: Deselect layers for a new shape layer; deliberately choose Shape or Mask mode.

checks: Procedural Rectangle Path rather than Bézier path
fix: Convert shape path to Bézier Path, then select Path and vertex. Preserve parametric form if you still need width/corner sliders.

symptom: Path pasted into Position doesn't follow correctly
checks: Wrong path/property selection; position separation; space transforms; dimensions
fix: Copy actual Path property, paste on Position with playhead at desired time, inspect spatial path.

symptom: Auto-Orient flips or points the wrong way
checks: Original artwork direction, tangent, parent transform, spatial path
fix: Use Auto-Orient Along Path and rotate source art/precomp for desired leading direction.

checks: 3D switch vs geometry extrusion, render engine, mesh type, camera/light
fix: A 3D switch creates a plane; actual geometric depth requires supported geometry/renderer and property controls.

checks: Layer material settings, 3D renderer, light type, lighting switch or blend style
fix: Verify compatible renderer and Accepts Lights/material properties.

checks: Layer motion-blur switch, comp master motion-blur switch, shutter angle, type of animation
fix: Enable both switches and verify shutter angle/samples; FX blur may behave differently.

checks: Propagation, segmentation boundary, view resolution, clip cuts, occlusion, strokes too broad
fix: Work close to source/full resolution, make small corrections, propagate in short spans, refine and freeze.

checks: Too aggressive Clip Black/White, Shrink/Grow, despill, suppression
fix: Inspect Keylight Screen Matte; aim for clean black background, white subject and sensible grey edges.

checks: Premultiplied RGB contamination, poor despill, matte chatter, uncorrected edge colors
fix: Check straight/premultiplied interpretation, use edge color decontamination/despill, slight blur/choke only if needed.

symptom: Animation seems to speed up unpredictably
checks: Unequal keyframe timing, nonlinear Graph Editor easing, path distances, frame rate
fix: Examine motion-path dots, timing, speed graph and roving keys. Equal time between keys ≠ constant spatial speed.

checks: Timeline snapping / graph options
fix: Graph Editor → Choose Graph Type and Options → Allow Keyframes Between Frames (when supported). Rendering still samples actual frame times.

checks: Large footage, many layers, effects, GPU memory, disk cache, insufficient RAM, compressed media
fix: Start with 1/4 preview and shorter work area; disable heaviest effects; test transcoded sources; inspect cache/disk.

checks: Variable frame rate footage, interpretation mismatch, mixed sample rates, time stretching
fix: Convert VFR footage to constant frame rate; confirm comp rate, audio 48 kHz where appropriate; inspect source timing.

checks: Missing font or font-axis support, font version mismatch, plugin effects
fix: Package font/license details, verify exact font and open a test copy on target machine.

checks: Work area vs entire comp; proxy; guide layers; 3D/camera, output color/bit depth; motion blur/sample settings
fix: Render a short test with the intended output module and compare RGB/alpha/color.

checks: Corrupt frame, GPU driver, unsupported plugin, insufficient disk space, bad source segment
fix: Narrow to failing frame/time, disable suspected effect, render a short image sequence, review log, update plugin/driver responsibly.
